systems.system: national fibre optic transmission backbone, Phase IV
systems.platform: about 12,000 km of terrestrial fibre and roughly 812 km of overhead fibre on electricity poles; Phase IV could add 4,000 km
systems.owner: CAMTEL; loan of 1.35 billion yuan (about US$195 million) from China Eximbank authorised by decree of 6 March 2026
systems.tiers: major urban centres and underserved areas; no local government office named

note: A backbone loan; no local government office is said to be on the network.
